talent.title: Will of Tichondrius
talent.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Fel Claws to permanently increase Fel Claw's damage by 0.25. Quest: Hit 4 Heroes in the first 2 slashes to cause the final slash to increase damage by 1.  Reward: Upon gaining 20 bonus damage, the final Stun is increased by 0.25 seconds and the final slash steals 4% of enemy Hero Health.

talent.title: Might of Sargeras
talent.description: Necrotic Embrace now provides 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

talent.title: Spreading Plague
talent.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration.  Does not wake Sleeping targets.

talent.title: Dark Conversion
talent.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

talent.title: Deep Sleep
talent.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 15%.

talent.title: Blind as a Bat
talent.description: Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 5.5 seconds.  Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.  Does not provide quest stacks while active.

talent.title: Maelstrom Weapon
talent.description: Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.  Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

talent.title: Mana Tide
talent.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

talent.title: Ancestral Wrath
talent.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.  Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

talent.title: Sundering
talent.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

talent.title: Frostwolf's Grace
talent.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

talent.title: Alpha Wolf
talent.description: For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage.  Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

talent.title: Stormcaller
talent.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%.  Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

talent.title: Electric Charge
talent.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.  While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

talent.title: Blood and Thunder
talent.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 4% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

talent.title: Ancestral Healing
talent.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

talent.title: Earth Shield
talent.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

talent.title: Rising Storm
talent.description: Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

talent.title: Envenomed Nest
talent.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds.

talent.title: Prolific Dispersal
talent.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

talent.title: Vile Nest
talent.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

talent.title: Ultimate Evolution
talent.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

talent.title: Bombard Strain
talent.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and they now lose health 40% more slowly.

talent.title: Survival Instincts
talent.description: Reduce damage taken by Locusts from non-Heroes by 50% and increase their damage by 60%.

talent.title: Puncturing Arrow
talent.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1.  Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

talent.title: Repeating Arrow
talent.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

talent.title: Monster Hunter
talent.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talent.title: Strafe
talent.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

talent.title: Gloom
talent.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

talent.title: Manticore
talent.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

talent.title: Righteous Assault
talent.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

talent.title: Heavy Burden
talent.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

talent.title: Glimmer of Hope
talent.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

talent.title: Crystal Aegis
talent.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

talent.title: Piercing Lash
talent.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

talent.title: Lion's Maw
talent.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

talent.title: Taunt
talent.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

talent.title: Lionheart
talent.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

talent.title: Shield Wall
talent.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

talent.title: Mortal Strike
talent.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

talent.title: Advanced Artillery
talent.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

talent.title: Regenerative Bio-Steel
talent.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

talent.title: Hover Siege Mode
talent.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

talent.title: Napalm Strike
talent.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

talent.title: Hyper-Cooling Engines
talent.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

talent.title: Simple Geometry
talent.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

talent.title: Explosive Arrows
talent.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

talent.title: Never Outmatched
talent.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

talent.title: Dragon's Arrow
talent.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

talent.title: Mounted Archery
talent.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds. Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

talent.title: Unrivaled Strength
talent.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 75%.

talent.title: Indomitable
talent.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

talent.title: Oppressor
talent.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talent.title: Warlord's Challenge
talent.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

talent.title: Double Up
talent.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 5 seconds.
